items.title: 5.8 Steady, non-viscous aur ideal fluid (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.8 with Figs. 5.11 to 5.14 (PDF 104-106).

blocks.text: Behte hue fluids (liquids aur gases) bohat ahem hain. Behte fluid ka rawayya samajhne ke liye hum pipes mein us ka bahao (flow) dekhte hain. Fluid do tarah beh sakta hai: streamline ya turbulent.
Streamline ya Laminar Flow

Flow ko streamline ya laminar (tahon mein hamwar bahao) kehte hain agar kisi khaas point se guzarne wala har particle (zarra) bilkul usi raste par chale jis par is point se pehle guzarne wale particles chale the.

blocks.alt: Pipe jo baen taraf chaura hai aur hamwar taur par daen taraf tang ho jata hai. Hamwar streamlines ek doosre ko kate baghair us ke saath chalti hain aur tang hisse mein qareeb aa jati hain. Oopar teer baen se daen bahao dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.11: Streamlines (laminar flow) (kitab ki Figure 5.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Steady flow mein particles ki harkat hamwar (smooth) aur ba-qaida hoti hai (Fig. 5.11). Laminar flow mein fluid particles jis hamwar raste par chalte hain use streamline kehte hain. Streamline seedhi bhi ho sakti hai aur muri hui bhi; kisi bhi point par us ki tangent (us point ko chhoone wali seedhi lakeer) flow ki direction batati hai. Do streamlines ek doosre ko kaat (cross) nahi saktin.

Misal: pipe mein behte fluid (Fig. 5.12) ki velocity P par v₁, Q par v₂ aur isi tarah aage hoti hai. Agar P, Q aur R par particle ki velocity waqt ke saath na badle to flow ko steady flow ya streamline flow kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Halka sa mura pipe jis mein ek streamline bani hai. Streamline par nuqton P, Q aur R par teer v1, v2 aur v3 zarraat ki velocities dikhate hain, har ek streamline ke tangent ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.12: Streamline ke mukhtalif nuqton par zarraat ki velocities (kitab ki Figure 5.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Particle ke raste ko dikhane wali lakeer PQR streamline hai. Yeh woh fixed rasta hai jis par particles ek tarteeb se (ek ke peechhe ek) chalte hain. Streamline flow mein P se guzarne wale sab particles Q aur R se bhi guzarte hain. Is ka matlab hai ke do streamlines ek doosre ko kaat nahi saktin.
Turbulent Flow

blocks.title: Turbulent flow
blocks.text: Fluid ke be-qaida (irregular) ya ghair-mustaqil (unsteady) bahao ko turbulent flow kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen se aate bahao ke raste mein ek chapti kaali plate khari hai. Beech ki lakeer plate se takrati hai; oopar aur neeche ki lakeerein us ke kinaron se mur kar plate ke peechhe ki taraf wapas ghoomti hain aur bhanwar (eddies) banati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.13: Turbulent flow (kitab ki Figure 5.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Jab fluid ki velocity ek khaas had se barh jaye to us ki harkat be-qaida aur ghair-mustaqil ho jati hai. Is halat mein fluid ki velocity achanak badalti hai (Fig. 5.13), aur particles ka theek theek rasta bataya nahi ja sakta.

Agar do streamlines ek doosre ko kaatein to particles kabhi ek taraf aur kabhi doosri taraf jayenge, aur flow steady nahi rahega. Aisa flow turbulent hai. Turbulent flow mein bhanwar (eddies aur whirlpools) bante hain aur particles ke raste lagatar badalte rehte hain.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Formula One racing cars ka design streamlined hota hai (hawa un ke gird hamwar behti hai). Dolphins ke jism bhi streamlined hain, jo pani mein tez harkat mein madad karte hain.
Ideal Fluid
Jo fluid yeh shartein poori kare use ideal (misali) fluid kehte hain:

items: Fluid non-viscous ho, yani fluid ki saath saath wali tahon (layers) ke darmiyan koi friction (ragar) ki force na ho.
Fluid incompressible ho, yani dabane se na dabe aur us ki density constant rahe.

blocks.text: Rate of Flow (bahao ki sharah)

blocks.title: Rate of flow
blocks.text: Pipe ke kisi bhi section se har unit time (har second) mein guzarne wale fluid ke volume ko rate of flow kehte hain.
Rate of Flow ka formula
Ek pipe lein jis ka cross-sectional area A hai (Fig. 5.14). Fluid ki velocity v hai aur woh time t tak behta hai. Time t mein fluid ka tay kiya faasla:

blocks.alt: Pipe ek lamba khula cylinder hai jis ka cross-sectional raqba A hai. Andar fluid ka rangeen satoon (column) lambai v x t ka hai, jo pipe ke neeche do dashed lakeeron ke darmiyan dohre teer se dikhaya gaya hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.14: Liquid ke bahao ki sharah (kitab ki Figure 5.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yahan ℓ pipe ki woh lambai hai jo fluid time t mein tay karta hai. Time t mein pipe se guzarne wale fluid ka volume:

blocks.latex: \text{Thus}\quad \text{The rate of flow of the liquid} = \frac{\text{Volume}}{\text{Time}} = \frac{Avt}{t} = Av
blocks.text_alt: Thus The rate of flow of the liquid = Volume/Time = Avt/t = Av

blocks.text: SI units mein rate of flow cubic metre per second (m³ s⁻¹) mein napa jata hai; kabhi kabhi litre per second (L s⁻¹) mein bhi.
Steady Flow

blocks.title: Steady flow
blocks.text: Agar poore flow ka pattern waqt ke saath na badle to us flow ko steady flow kehte hain.
Steady flow mein fluid ka har particle usi flow line par chalta hai jis par us se pehle wala particle chala tha.

blocks.caption: Streamline aur turbulent flow ka farq
rows: har particle pehle walon ka rasta leta hai; streamlines kabhi nahi kattin

blocks.prompt: Streamline aur turbulent flow mein farq batayein. 0.05 m diameter ke pipe mein pani 2 m s⁻¹ se beh raha hai; rate of flow kitna hai?
blocks.explanation: Streamline flow hamwar aur ba-qaida hai: kisi point se guzarne wala har particle wahi rasta leta hai aur streamlines ek doosre ko nahi kaatin. Turbulent flow ek khaas velocity se oopar be-qaida aur ghair-mustaqil hota hai, bhanwar bante hain aur raste badalte rehte hain. Rate of flow = Av = πr²v = 3.14 × (0.025)² × 2 ≈ 3.9 × 10⁻³ m³ s⁻¹, yani taqreeban 3.9 L s⁻¹.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Streamline (laminar) flow: hamwar, ba-qaida; har particle pehle walon ka rasta leta hai; streamlines kabhi nahi kattin; tangent flow ki direction batati hai.
Turbulent flow: be-qaida, ghair-mustaqil, bhanwar; ek khaas velocity se oopar.
Rate of flow = volume/time = Av (m³ s⁻¹ ya L s⁻¹). Steady flow: pattern waqt ke saath nahi badalta.
